description: Mini-OpenClaw 改进路线：围绕离线评测、可观测性、多用户隔离、失败兜底和垂直 Demo，把当前可运行 Agent 原型推进成可解释、可量化、可写进简历的工程样板。

userStories.title: Add offline eval runner and 20-task seed dataset
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a one-command offline evaluation runner plus a seed dataset so Mini-OpenClaw can quantify baseline task completion instead of relying on screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `backend/evals/` with a reusable runner module and dataset loader
Seed at least 20 evaluation tasks under `backend/evals/datasets/`
Tasks cover file reading, skill inspection, terminal usage, multi-turn context, and knowledge retrieval
Runner supports `python -m backend.evals.runner --dataset ... --output ...`
Generated JSON report includes `task_success_rate`, `tool_call_success_rate`, `average_latency_ms`, `average_tool_calls`, and `failure_category_distribution`
Add unit tests for dataset loading, metrics aggregation, and report writing
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented a JSON-backed offline eval runner under backend/evals with a 20-task seed dataset covering file reading, skills, terminal, multi-turn context, and knowledge retrieval. Added unit tests for dataset loading, metrics aggregation, and report writing. The CLI now supports `python -m backend.evals.runner --dataset ... --output ...` and emits a JSON report with task success rate, tool-call success rate, latency, tool usage, and failure-category distribution.

userStories.title: Add ablation profiles and Markdown eval report
userStories.description: As a developer, I need self-comparison baselines so the evaluation suite can prove whether memory, skills, and retrieval improve outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: Add eval profiles for baseline, no_memory, no_skills, and no_retrieval
Runner can execute multiple profiles in one invocation
Generate a Markdown summary beside the JSON report
Markdown report includes at least one ablation comparison table
Profile configuration is file-based and easy to extend
Add tests for profile selection and Markdown rendering
Tests pass

userStories.title: Record structured chat traces to local JSON logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need every chat run to emit a trace so failures and latency can be diagnosed later.
acceptanceCriteria: Each `/api/chat` request gets a unique `trace_id`
Persist traces under `backend/data/traces/` as JSON files
Each trace records `session_id`, `start_time`, `end_time`, `latency_ms`, `model_name`, `tool_calls`, `tool_failures`, `final_status`, and `token_usage` when available
Streaming and non-streaming chat flows both write traces
Add tests for successful and failed trace persistence
Tests pass

userStories.title: Expose trace list and detail APIs
userStories.description: As the frontend, I need to query recent traces so the app can surface runtime diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `GET /api/traces` returning recent trace summaries
Add `GET /api/traces/{trace_id}` returning the full trace payload
Trace summary includes `trace_id`, `session_id`, `latency_ms`, `final_status`, and `created_at`
Missing traces return HTTP 404
Add integration tests for list, detail, and missing-trace cases
Tests pass

userStories.title: Add frontend trace panel for sessions
userStories.description: As a user, I need a lightweight trace view so I can inspect tool calls, failures, and latency after each conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend loads trace summaries for the active session
A right-side trace panel shows status, latency, tool calls, and failures
Selecting a trace reveals the full ordered event list
Failed traces are visually distinct from successful traces
Manual browser verification covers the main trace flow
Relevant frontend checks pass

userStories.title: Isolate sessions, memory, and workspace by user_id
userStories.description: As a product-minded developer, I need per-user storage boundaries so different users cannot see each other's local state.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce `user_id` support via `X-User-ID` header plus frontend override
Move stateful files under `backend/data/users/{user_id}/...`
Sessions, memory, and workspace paths are user-scoped
Default anonymous user still works without configuration
Add tests proving user A and user B are physically isolated
Tests pass

userStories.title: Serialize per-user writes with async locks
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to prevent concurrent writes from corrupting the same user's files.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an in-process async lock registry keyed by `user_id`
Session writes and mutable file writes for the same user are serialized
Different users can still proceed concurrently
Add tests covering concurrent same-user and cross-user writes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Classify runtime failures and return friendly fallbacks
userStories.description: As a user, I need the system to explain failures instead of silently breaking.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement error categories: `tool_timeout`, `tool_invalid_input`, `model_invalid_format`, `memory_read_failure`, `knowledge_retrieval_failure`, `max_iterations_exceeded`
Attach the category to trace records and API error payloads
Add retry / fallback helpers for recoverable cases
Frontend shows a user-friendly failure state instead of hanging
Add tests for at least three distinct categories
Tests pass

userStories.title: Expand boundary tests for failure scenarios
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need regression coverage for the most common failure edges before adding more features.
acceptanceCriteria: Add tests for invalid shell commands, missing files, long-text parse failure handling, and empty retrieval results
At least one API-level test asserts the frontend-visible payload is non-silent on failure
Document the failure matrix in the repo
Tests pass

userStories.title: Ship an interview-assistant vertical demo pack
userStories.description: As a hiring-facing developer, I need one concrete vertical scenario so the project demonstrates real utility beyond a generic chat shell.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a focused knowledge pack for interview Q&A under `backend/knowledge/`
Add one to two dedicated skills for interview prep
Seed at least five demo prompts or scenarios
Document the demo workflow and screenshot checklist
Frontend exposes the demo materials in a discoverable way
Relevant checks pass
